third_party_evaluations.summary: 3-day advanced web pentest: chained vulns, business-logic, deserialization, SSRF.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded three-day advanced web assessment, chained vulnerabilities and three-year profile support professional delivery; practical depth does not alone establish expert enterprise-wide security direction.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A three-day practical with chained flaws, business logic, deserialization and SSRF supports professional web-pentest delivery. The three-year profile fits domain ownership, while no evidence establishes expert direction across offensive disciplines.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded three-day practical addresses chained vulnerabilities, business logic, deserialization and SSRF. That applied complexity supports professional web-assessment delivery at a three-year level.
